fields.name: config
fields.docs: Immutable runtime configuration.

fields.name: context
fields.docs: Authoritative conversation context shared with the running agent.

fields.name: tools
fields.docs: Tool execution state (tools, hooks).

fields.name: guard
fields.docs: Guard / safety state.

fields.name: snapshot_manager
fields.docs: Snapshot manager (from memory subsystem).

fields.name: client
fields.docs: HTTP client.

fields.name: llm_client
fields.docs:
Optional trait-level LLM client. When present, the streaming core loop
(`create_llm_stream`) and `direct_answer_stream` route LLM calls through
this trait object instead of the raw `client` + model-resolve path —
enabling test doubles (MockLlmClient) to drive the full ReAct loop.
Production agents inject a real `LlmClient` implementation; execution
returns a configuration error when none is attached.

fields.name: thinking
fields.docs:
Per-agent thinking-depth config, propagated to the think phase and react
loop so each LLM request carries the configured reasoning depth. `None`
means "use the model's default" (no thinking field sent).

fields.name: cancel_token
fields.docs: Cancellation token (set after construction).

fields.name: recently_read_files
fields.docs: Recently read files for read-before-edit enforcement (path → read instant).

fields.name: run_store
fields.docs: Run store for trace persistence.

fields.name: current_run_id
fields.docs: Current run ID.

fields.name: trace_run_id
fields.docs:
Unique trace invocation ID. This is intentionally distinct from the
product/business run ID in `current_run_id`.

fields.name: current_turn_id
fields.docs: Current user-input/agent turn ID.

fields.name: current_message_id
fields.docs: Message that triggered the current invocation.

fields.name: current_message
fields.docs: Typed active user message, including any attachments.

fields.name: current_execution_id
fields.docs: Current concrete subagent/tool execution ID.

fields.name: external_cancel
fields.docs:
外部 run 级上下文（跨 spawn 安全，从 ReactAgent.external_* 抓取）。
与 current_run_id 同源、同生命周期（set/clear 在同一处）。

fields.name: subagent_lineage
fields.docs:
Identity/lineage of the dispatched Subagent attempt this snapshot runs.
`None` for primary agent invocations. Copied into every ToolContext.

fields.name: external_uplink
fields.docs:
Uplink channel for Subagent→parent / Subagent→sibling messaging,
installed by the dispatcher into the invocation's runtime context.

fields.name: resource_guards
fields.docs: Opaque ownership tokens retained for this invocation and its tools.

fields.name: token_tracker
fields.docs: Token usage tracker shared with the parent ReactAgent.

fields.name: calibrated_tokenizer
fields.docs:
Self-calibrating tokenizer shared with the parent ReactAgent. The think
phase feeds real `usage.prompt_tokens` back into it so context-window
and compression estimates converge to the model's actual tokenization.

fields.name: state_store
fields.docs:
Runtime state store for ReAct checkpointing (messages + skills).
Legacy `current_plan` values remain raw Store data and are not restored.

fields.name: conversation_store
fields.docs:
Conversation store for user-visible transcript projection. When both
this and `config.conversation_id` are set, the run loop persists
projected messages at every finalization point so application UI history is
always in sync with the running context — without each entry point
having to re-implement the save logic.

fields.name: critic
fields.docs: Optional Critic for final_answer verification.

fields.name: tool_execution_pipeline
fields.docs: Optional tool execution pipeline (17-stage middleware).

fields.name: memory_layer_manager
fields.docs:
(stage4 E1) Layered memory manager — used by `pre_compaction_flush` to
write durable facts before compression. Cloned from the parent ReactAgent.

fields.name: pre_model_context_projector
fields.docs: Optional application projection refreshed at the pre-prepare boundary.

fields.name: skill_mutation_authority
fields.docs: Consumer-supplied canonical Skill lifecycle mutation authority.
